1.w: Brothers, even if a man should be overtaken in some trespass, you⁺ the spiritual ones, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking at yourself, lest you also be tempted.

2.w: Bear one another’s burdens and thus you⁺ will fulfill the law of Christ.

3.w: For if anyone thinks [himself] to be something being nothing, he deceives himself.

4.w: But let each test his own work, and then he will have boasting in regard to himself alone, and not in regard to another.

5.w: For each will bear his own load.

6.w: Now let the one being instructed in the word share with the one instructing in all good things.

7.w: Do not be led astray: God is not mocked. For whatever a man may sow, this also he will reap.

8.w: For the one sowing to his flesh, from the flesh will reap corruption; but the one sowing to the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

9.w: And we should not grow fainthearted [in] doing good, for in due time we will reap, not giving up.

10.w: So then, as we have opportunity, we should work good toward all, and especially toward those of the household of the faith.

11.w: See what large letters I have written to you⁺ with my own hand!

12.w: As many as want to have a fair appearance in the flesh, these compel you⁺ to be circumcised, only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

13.w: For not even those being circumcised keep the law themselves, but they want you⁺ to be circumcised that they may boast in your⁺ flesh.

14.w: But for me, may it be never to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I [to] the world.

15.w: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything, but a new creation.

16.w: And as many as those who will walk by this rule, peace and mercy [be] upon them, and upon the Israel of God.

17.w: Henceforth, let no one cause to me troubles, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.

18.w: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your⁺ spirit, brothers. Amen.
